item.title: DeepSeek Under the Hood: Dissecting MoE Architectures and Practical Deployment
item.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm, but their sheer size often presents significant challenges in terms of training, inference, and cost. Enter DeepSeek, a family of powerful models that brings innovation through architectural choices, particularly the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm in DeepSeek-V2 and specialized training for DeepSeek-Coder. This deep-dive explores the ‘how’ and ‘why’ behind DeepSeek’s efficiency and capabilities, moving beyond surface-level benchmarks to the nitty-gritty of its architecture and practical deployment.

item.title: Unpacking RAG: An Under-the-Hood Deep Dive into Retrieval Augmented Generation Architectures
item.description: The promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) is transformative, yet their Achilles’ heel often lies in their knowledge cutoff and propensity for ‘hallucinations.’ Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) emerged as a powerful paradigm to address these limitations, grounding LLM responses in factual, external knowledge. But beyond the high-level concept of ‘retrieving and generating,’ what does a robust, production-ready RAG system truly entail? This deep dive will pull back the curtain, exploring the architectural nuances, core components, and common challenges in building sophisticated RAG applications.
